system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.12.2 - Watery Ways. Steam and scalding-water attacks (Steam Wall/Bolt, Cone/Cube of Steam), remote hearing and vision through a body of water, teleporting a target or a vessel within the same body of water (Water Door, Vessel Door), gates that instantly transport a designated target (Water Gate), holding a vessel fast against movement (Hold Craft), desiccating a target to death, and swamping a boat's deck (Upsurge). Fidelity note: level 50's table name is "Water Gate True" but its own description heading reads "Mass Water Gate" - kept the table's name for the entry, description text as printed.
Creates a small area of steam. Contact with steam will cause an 'A' heat critical. Generally used to cook crustaceans and sterilize goods.

Target in a body of water is transported up to 10' per level of the caster, within that body of water. Water must be at least 6" deep at both locations. This spell fails if the target is not in sufficient water. If destination isn't deep enough, target is transported to the closest point to the destination, within the body of water.
Caster can move his Hearing sense up and down one body of water, within range of the spell. Point of hearing is 6 inches above the water.
Caster is aware of all creatures/beings within one body of water as long as they are in range of this spell. Approximate location is known as well. (Fishermen pay handsomely for this spell).
One small wooden vessel (canoe, rowboat, etc.) and all of its contents/passengers are moved up to 10' per level of the caster, within the same body of water.
Allows caster to completely ignore sounds of natural water (e.g., like lapping waves, but not splashing by creatures or oars in the water). Very useful for the Listening spell.

A small portal is opened in the body of water (half of it is above water and half is below). When designated target moves into the portal, the target is instantly transported to any point in the same body of water. Area to which transported must have been seen by the caster either through the Vision spell or in person. The following chance of failure exist: Never seen place (but has had it described)=50%; Been briefly (one hour or less)=25%; Studied (been in for 24 hours) = 1%; Lived in (for at least one year) = .01%. In case of failure, first determine the direction of error (randomly, for all directions including up and down). Then determine the amount of the error by making an open-ended d100 roll, the amount of which is the number of feet the target is moved.
Caster can move his point of visual perception to any point in one body of water that is in range. Point of vision is 6 inches above the water.
Caster summons a wall of super-heated water and vapor (up to 10' x 10'). Attacks through wall are reduced by 60% and movement through wall delivers an 'A' heat critical.
A bolt of super heated water and vapor is shot from the caster's palm. Attacks on Ice Bolt Table delivering Heat criticals and secondary Impact criticals.

Causes water to harden around a target vessel, resisting movement. A small vessel is held and cannot move while the caster concentrates. Medium vessels move at -50 ft per round. Large vessels move -25 feet per round.

As Wall of Steam, except it creates a cube of steam (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical; attacks through the steam are at a -20.
As Water Gate I, except that a small vessel is transported (with all its contents.)
As Vessel Door I, except it can affect up to a medium sized vessel.
As Hold Craft I, except medium vessels are held and large vessels have their movement rate reduced by 50 ft per round.

Caster tries to remove water content from the target. If the target fails to resist, they are at -10 to all their actions and stunned 1 rnd per 10 failure. Penalties last until healed. Targets that reach a penalty of 150 become dried-out husks and are quite dead.
A cone of super-heated steam is shot from the caster' palm. The cone is 50' long and is 10' wide at its full extent. Attack is resolved on the Fire Ball Table.
Caster causes current beneath the target boat to surge upward, knocking the ship up and down. Attacks this round, from anyone on the ship, are at -50.
As Vessel Door I, except it can affect up to large sized vessels.
As Water Gate II, except that up to medium-sized vessels may be transported.
As Hold Craft I, except up to large vessels are held and cannot move.
As Water Gate I, except that up to large vessels may be transported.
As Water Gate IV, except a number of vessels equal to one quarter of caster's level may be transported.
